content: Windows TUI ANSI pitfalls: (1) VTP (ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_PROCESSING) is not enabled by default in old conhost.exe — must call SetConsoleMode explicitly. (2) cmd.exe disables VTP for child processes when spawning subprocesses, resetting terminal state. (3) isatty() returning true does not confirm VTP is active. (4) BubbleTea v2 has active regression (issue #1601): WindowSizeMsg is never sent on resize on Windows because VT input mode dropped ConInput's WINDOW_BUFFER_SIZE_EVENT handling. (5) Must poll for resize on Windows using tea tick + term.GetSize(). (6) Windows Terminal (default since Windows 11 22H2) supports ANSI by default; conhost.exe has compatibility limitations. (7) go-ansi library provides Windows-portable ANSI escape sequence utilities as a fallback.
